title: Train Tower Defense
author: MrLawliet
selftext:
I've been working on **The Last Train**, a survival shooter where your train is your fortress and the enemies just keep coming.

The idea was to combine the addictive upgrade mechanics of Vampire Survivors with a heavily armed moving train. You defend five wagons against waves of flying enemies, man an enormous cannon, deploy bombs, and collect upgrades every 30 seconds to turn your train into a rolling death machine.

There are different enemy types, plenty of unlockable upgrades, and ten biomes to survive. Each run lasts around six minutes, with different ways to build up your firepower.

I've been a developer for a couple of decades, and AI has finally made it possible to bring ideas like this to life without needing an entire studio. I've used it extensively for programming, artwork, and gameplay refinement.

**Google Play (full game):**  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastexitdiner.lasttrain](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastexitdiner.lasttrain)

**Steam (free demo):**  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5077680/Last\_Exit\_Diner\_The\_Last\_Train/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5077680/Last_Exit_Diner_The_Last_Train/)

Would love feedback on the gameplay, upgrades, and balancing if anyone gives it a try!
